title: Nothing OS 4.1 (Galaxian-B4.1-260819-1839)
description:
What's New in This Update New Features

🎮 Added Games widgets to the widget drawer, letting you access your recently played mini-games with just a single tap.

General Improvements and Bug Fixes

💬 Fixed an issue where third-party notifications could crash unexpectedly in certain scenarios.
⚙️ Enhanced overall system stability.
🛡️ Updated to August 2026 security patch.

Notes:
Your device may use more power and feel warmer during installation. Performance will return to normal after the update is complete.
